atoms.sound: Good morning Ana. Welcome to your first day at Style Point. We’ll start with a short list for new staff so you know what jobs you need to do during your shift.

atoms.text: A young woman walks into Style Point. She looks around quietly. Ana sees her but is not sure what to do first.

trainers.instruction: Which rule on the list should Ana follow first? Choose.

atoms.sound: Hey, how are you? Can I help you with anything?

b: Stay next to the customer and keep talking.
++Let the customer look around on her own.
Tell the customer about a discount.
Ask again if she needs help.

atoms.text: After the customer leaves, Ana folds a few jumpers and puts a shirt back on the shelf. She notices that some clothes are not in the right place. She puts them back where they belong.

trainers.instruction: Which rule on the list did Ana follow? Choose.

atoms.sound: You’re doing well so far, Ana. Now I’ll show you how the checkout works. Watch me first. Then you can try with the next customer.

atoms.a: Hello, I’d like to buy this jacket. I saw that it’s on sale. What’s the final price?
atoms.b: Hello, I’d like to buy this jacket. I saw that it’s ((on_sale)). What’s the final price?
